_doc: Bank salary-transfer offer pages and their T&C documents, watched weekly by the 'salary-transfer' monitor (scripts/monitor/setup.mjs). Like offers, this is a per-BANK surface rather than per-card, which is why it lives here and not on scripts/scrape/banks/<slug>.urls.json. Entries here are alert-only and are never auto-scraped: the salaryTransferOffers collection is entirely typed editor content (salary bands, reward amounts, clawback terms) with no free-text scraper equivalent at all, so a change routes to the business-realestate editor and the deals desk to be typed up against the source. Cadence is weekly rather than daily because salary-transfer promotions move on quarterly campaign cycles; see the credit budget in CLAUDE.md.
_admission_standard: A URL enters `banks` only on evidence, never on plausibility. Either (a) two independent signals — an editor verified it as a live entry's sourceUrl AND discovery independently re-surfaced it — or (b) scripts/monitor/verify-candidates.ts fetched it and returned SUPPORTED. Plausibility is not enough: salaryTransferOfferHistory records that adcb.com/en/personal/promotions/salary-transfer and rakbank.ae/personal/accounts/salary-transfer both returned 404 on re-verification (30 June 2026) despite reading like perfectly ordinary salary-transfer URLs. Candidates that fail stay in _pending with their verdict recorded.

banks._evidence: Campaign page: live sourceUrl of emirates-nbd-ongoing-2026.mdx, re-surfaced by discovery runs 30982700538 and 30985646889. T&C PDF: verify run 30988856840 returned SUPPORTED (AED 5000, minSalary 5000). Landing page + T&C pair, which is the shape this surface wants.

NEO page: live sourceUrl of mashreq-2026.mdx, re-surfaced by both discovery runs. Gold page: verify run 30988856840 returned SUPPORTED with the strongest signal set of any candidate (AED 50000, minSalary 25000, band language present).

Verify run 30988856840 returned SUPPORTED (AED 8000, minSalary 8000). NOTE: this is NOT the dib-xtra-tc.pdf cited by the live dib-xtra-2026.mdx entry, whose bands start at AED 5,000. Two distinct documents both carrying salary-transfer terms — watching this one is safe, but which is current is an editorial question flagged to the business-realestate desk.

_pending._doc: Candidates that have been fetched but did not meet the admission standard. Verdicts reflect re-verify run 30990596839 (which followed the detector widening) and, where unchanged, run 30988856840. Not watched. A candidate needs two strong signals — AED amount, minimum salary, band language, clawback wording — on a reachable page that mentions salary transfer. Nothing here currently qualifies; the remaining work is locating better URLs by hand rather than re-running the tool.

adib.verdict: WEAK (re-verify run 30990596839) — the detector fix worked: this was previously NO SALARY-TRANSFER CONTENT purely because mentionsSalaryTransfer did not know the phrase 'salary bonus'. It is now correctly recognised as salary-transfer content. It still does not qualify: only one strong signal (AED 3,000), where admission needs two. The bands and clawback terms are presumably in a section the scrape did not reach, or in another document. Worth a human look — this is the closest of the remaining candidates to being real.

rakbank.verdict: WEAK on all three (unchanged across runs 30988856840 and 30990596839) — reachable and about salary transfer, but almost no offer detail; only /rak-more returns a minimum salary of AED 5,000. Likely marketing pages with the terms in a document not yet located, or content rendered client-side. RAKBANK's previous sourceUrl 404'd, so these paths are at least current.

standard-chartered.verdict: NO SALARY-TRANSFER CONTENT (unchanged across both runs) — an application form carries little prose. The landing page without /apply is the better watch target and was never proposed by discovery; locate by hand.

adcb.verdict: WEAK (unchanged across both runs) — reachable, carries AED 12,000, but no bands or clawback, and the document is dated March 2017. ADCB's previous sourceUrl 404'd and no current page was found by either discovery run. Needs manual sourcing.

emirates-islamic.verdict: NO SALARY-TRANSFER CONTENT (unchanged across both runs) — a WPS prepaid card for employees, not a salary-transfer offer, as suspected when it was proposed. The AED=3 signal is a spurious parse. Emirates Islamic's archived sourceUrl was never primary-source-verified either; needs manual sourcing.

enbd_secondary.verdict: WEAK (re-verify run 30990596839) — the earlier UNREACHABLE was a transient Firecrawl HTTP 408, not a dead page; it resolved on retry and carries AED 15,000. Still only one strong signal, so it stays out. ENBD's main campaign page and T&C PDF are already admitted, so this adds little even if confirmed.

_no_candidate.note: Neither discovery run found any candidate, including the retry pass with a second search term. FAB matters most, being the largest UAE bank. These need manual location.
